body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said on the morning of November 8 that, in the 24 hours from 6 a.m. on November 7 to 6 a.m. on November 8, it detected 6 PLA warships and 2 government vessels, and that 2 PLA aircraft sorties entered the airspace southwest of Taiwan.
The ministry stressed that the armed forces monitored the activity closely and responded with mission aircraft and vessels as well as land-based missile systems.
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said that in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. on November 8, it detected 6 PLA warships and 2 government vessels, with 2 PLA aircraft sorties entering the airspace southwest of Taiwan; the military said it monitored and responded with mission aircraft, vessels and land-based missile systems.
en.title: 6 PLA warships detected near Taiwan; 2 aircraft enter southwestern airspace

facts.claim: 自11月7日上午6時起至11月8日上午6時止，國防部偵獲6艘共艦、2艘公務船。
國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。

body: 國防部8日上午公布共機艦動態，統計自7日上午6時起至8日上午6時止，偵獲6艘共艦、2艘公務船，以及侵擾西南空域的2架次共機。
國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
zh.summary: 國防部8日上午公布共機艦動態，統計自7日上午6時至8日上午6時止，偵獲6艘共艦、2艘公務船，另有2架次共機侵擾西南空域；國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
zh.title: 國防部公布共機艦動態：6艘共艦、2架次共機擾西南空域
